mode.title: Scrape Mode
mode.description: daily = new notices since last run (uses stored last_run_date); historical = full 12-month backfill

counties.title: Counties
counties.description: Counties to scrape. Leave empty for all (Travis, Bell, Williamson).

types.title: Notice Types
types.description: Notice types. Leave empty for the default set (foreclosure, probate, tax_sale, tax_delinquent, lien, lis_pendens, fire_damage). code_violation is excluded from the default and is Travis-only (Austin Code Socrata API) — request it explicitly. fire_damage is also Travis-only (CTECC Real-Time Fire Socrata feed) but IS in the default set.

since_date.title: Since Date Override
since_date.description: Pull notices published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides mode-based date logic and the stored last_run_date.

rebuild_dedup_only.title: Rebuild Dedup Only
rebuild_dedup_only.description: One-shot mode: scrape all sources, seed seen_notice_ids with today's dedup keys, save state, exit WITHOUT running enrichment or sending notifications. Use once after a breaking change to dedup logic.

max_notices.title: Max Notices (smoke-test cap)
max_notices.description: Stop scraping after this many raw notices across all sources. 0 = no cap (default). Useful for smoke-testing the full pipeline without scraping thousands of records.

force_scraper_fail.title: Force Scraper Fail (alert drill)
force_scraper_fail.description: Alert-system drill: 'county/type' (e.g. 'bell/lien') makes that one scraper raise intentionally so you can verify the 🚨 health alert fires. Leave empty in production.

enable_obituary.title: Enable Obituary / Deceased-Owner Detection
enable_obituary.description: Search obituaries via Google + DuckDuckGo to detect deceased owners, then run heir verification + DM address lookup. Adds ~5-10 min/run. Uses Anthropic (Haiku) and Serper credits.

enable_ancestry.title: Enable Ancestry.com Lookup
enable_ancestry.description: Query Ancestry.com SSDI for heir DOD verification. Requires ANCESTRY credentials. Off by default.

enable_tracerfy.title: Enable Tracerfy Batch Skip Trace
enable_tracerfy.description: Run Tracerfy on deep-prospecting candidates (deceased owners / heir maps / DMs). Requires tracerfy_api_key with credits.

enable_trestle.title: Enable Trestle Phone Tier Scoring
enable_trestle.description: Score every discovered phone (DM #1 + heirs) with Trestle's 5-tier dial priority. Requires trestle_api_key and --enable-tracerfy.

research_entities.title: Research Entity-Owned Properties
research_entities.description: For LLC/Corp/Trust owners, run web search + LLM to find the real person behind the entity.

skip_smarty.title: Skip Smarty Address Standardization
skip_smarty.description: Skip USPS address standardization. Normally ON.

skip_zillow.title: Skip Zillow Enrichment
skip_zillow.description: Skip Zillow property enrichment (Zestimate, beds/baths, MLS status). Biggest compute consumer at ~6s/record — disable for cheaper runs.

skip_tax.title: Skip Tax Delinquency Enrichment
skip_tax.description: Skip Travis/Bell/Williamson CAD tax enrichment step.

skip_geocode.title: Skip Reverse-Geocode Retry
skip_geocode.description: Skip the reverse-geocode retry for addresses Smarty couldn't match.

skip_zip_filter.title: Skip Investor-ZIP Filter
skip_zip_filter.description: Disable the investor-active ZIP code filter. Keeps records from all ZIPs.

skip_condo_filter.title: Skip Condo/Townhouse Filter
skip_condo_filter.description: Keep condo/townhouse records instead of dropping them.

keep_listed.title: Keep Listed Properties
keep_listed.description: Keep Active/Pending/Sold/For-Rent records. Default OFF — Zillow-listed properties get filtered out post-enrichment.

keep_government_records.title: Keep Government-Owned Records
keep_government_records.description: Keep records owned by City Of, Travis County, State Of, etc. in the DataSift CSV. Default OFF — government records get dropped.

skip_heir_verification.title: Skip Heir Alive/Dead Verification
skip_heir_verification.description: Skip the heir verification loop (still runs obituary search).

obituary_workers.title: Obituary Workers
obituary_workers.description: Concurrent workers for obituary Phase A (default 4). Higher = faster but more rate-limit risk.

obituary_deadline_secs.title: Obituary Time Budget (secs from start)
obituary_deadline_secs.description: Wall-clock ceiling for the obituary step, measured from actor start. Past this, obituary enrichment stops and remaining records flow through unenriched (they still upload) — prevents the sequential Phase B from blowing the actor timeout. Set below your run timeout minus ~15min for upload/reports. 0 = unbounded.

exclude_vacant.title: Exclude Vacant Land
exclude_vacant.description: Remove vacant land parcels. Default OFF — kept.

exclude_commercial.title: Exclude Commercial Properties
exclude_commercial.description: Remove commercial properties. Default OFF — kept.

exclude_entities.title: Exclude Entity-Owned Properties
exclude_entities.description: Remove LLC/Corp/Trust owners (unless research_entities found a person). Default OFF — kept.

min_delinquent_years.title: Min Years Delinquent (Travis Tax)
min_delinquent_years.description: Travis tax-delinquent: minimum years behind on taxes (default 2).

min_delinquent_amount.title: Min $ Owed (Travis Tax)
min_delinquent_amount.description: Travis tax-delinquent: minimum total owed in dollars (default 3000).

skip_texdel_cleaner.title: Skip Travis Tax-Delinquent Skill Cleaner
skip_texdel_cleaner.description: Bypass the skill cleaner (overflow merge, address contamination strip, blank-zip resolver). Safety valve.

use_residential_proxy.title: Use Residential Proxy
use_residential_proxy.description: Route requests through Apify residential proxies. Default OFF on Free plan (saves quota). TX county sites don't require it.

notify_slack.title: Send Slack Notification
notify_slack.description: Post run summary + Travis tax-delinquent diff block (NEW/REPEAT/DROPPED) to Slack/Discord webhook.

state_kvs_name.title: Cross-run State KVS Name
state_kvs_name.description: Named key-value store for cross-run state (last_run_date, seen_notice_ids, *_texdel_state). Leave empty for the production default 'sift-stack-state'. Set to a throwaway name (e.g. 'sift-stack-state-test') to verify state round-trips without perturbing production.

upload_datasift_api.title: Auto-upload to DataSift (RAWPIPE)
upload_datasift_api.description: Push each per-notice-type CSV directly to DataSift via apiv2.reisift.io (REST API, no browser). Uses datasift_email + datasift_password secrets. ~4s/list. Lists are named SiftStack {date} - {notice_type}.

datasift_no_enrich.title: Skip DataSift Property Enrichment
datasift_no_enrich.description: Disable DataSift's server-side property enrichment (free SiftMap data: beds/baths/Zestimate/sqft). Only applies when upload_datasift_api is on.

datasift_no_skip_trace.title: Skip DataSift Skip-Trace
datasift_no_skip_trace.description: Disable post-upload skip-trace via the API. Skip-trace costs $0.15/owner and requires account balance. Only applies when upload_datasift_api is on.

google_drive_folder_id.title: Google Drive Folder ID (raw records → 00_Inbox/daily)
google_drive_folder_id.description: Drive folder ID for the raw scraped record CSVs — point this at 00_Inbox/daily (these are records, not leads). Leave empty to skip Drive upload.

google_drive_reports_folder_id.title: Google Drive Reports Folder ID (PDFs → 05_Deep-Prospecting-Reports)
google_drive_reports_folder_id.description: Drive folder ID for deep-prospecting PDF reports. Leave empty to send PDFs to the same folder as the CSVs.

google_drive_cleanup_folder_id.title: Google Drive Cleanup Folder ID (Sold/Resolved → 03_Sold-Cleanup)
google_drive_cleanup_folder_id.description: Drive folder ID for the drop-off cleanup CSV (Sold + Resolved). Leave empty to nest 03_Sold-Cleanup under the inbox folder instead.

google_drive_forensics_folder_id.title: Google Drive Forensics Folder ID (diff JSON → 04_Forensics-&-Audit)
google_drive_forensics_folder_id.description: Drive folder ID for cross-run diff JSON reports. Leave empty to nest 04_Forensics-&-Audit under the inbox folder instead.

google_drive_auto_folder.title: Auto-organize Drive uploads into dated subfolders
google_drive_auto_folder.description: Sort uploads into Year / MM-Month / County / Type folders instead of dropping them flat (e.g. 2026/07-July/Travis/probate/).

datasift_split_by_county.title: Split lead CSVs per county
datasift_split_by_county.description: Write one lead CSV per county+type (e.g. Travis_probate, Bell_probate) for per-county tracking, instead of one combined CSV per type. DataSift list names stay per-type.

google_service_account_key.title: Google Service Account Key (base64)
google_service_account_key.description: Base64-encoded service account JSON. Required if google_drive_folder_id is set.

apify_token.title: Apify Personal API Token
apify_token.description: Your Apify Personal API token (Console → Settings → Integrations → Personal API token). Required — Apify's auto-injected run token cannot access the cross-run state KVS. Paste once; scheduled runs inherit it.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API Key
anthropic_api_key.description: Claude Haiku for LLM parsing + obituary snippet analysis. Recommended.

openwebninja_api_key.title: OpenWeb Ninja API Key (Zillow)
openwebninja_api_key.description: Real-time Zillow Data API. Free tier 100/month.

serper_api_key.title: Serper.dev API Key
serper_api_key.description: Google search (obituary lookup + DM address). Free tier 2,500 queries.

firecrawl_api_key.title: Firecrawl API Key
firecrawl_api_key.description: JS-rendered page scraping for DM address extraction. Free tier 500 pages.

tracerfy_api_key.title: Tracerfy API Key
tracerfy_api_key.description: Batch skip-trace service. Required only if enable_tracerfy is true.

trestle_api_key.title: Trestle API Key
trestle_api_key.description: Phone validation + 5-tier dial priority. Required only if enable_trestle is true.

datasift_email.title: DataSift Email
datasift_email.description: app.reisift.io login. Required when upload_datasift_api is on.

datasift_password.title: DataSift Password
datasift_password.description: app.reisift.io password. Required when upload_datasift_api is on.

slack_webhook_url.title: Slack / Discord Webhook URL
slack_webhook_url.description: Webhook URL for run summary notifications.
